description: Turning the hosted engine's answers into what a person reads: which catalog message each HostedError variant gets, which sentence each subscription state gets, and the vault-password strength estimate. Hand-written per shell because this is presentation — Rust owns the rules underneath (the 12-character minimum, the error variants themselves). Android is the third copy (futo-notes#179).
note: PARTIAL (test-reduction lever C, 2026-09-24): the TS (hostedSyncErrors.test.ts / subscriptionState.test.ts / vaultPasswordStrength.test.ts) and Swift (HostedSyncErrorsTests.swift / SubscriptionStateTests.swift / VaultPasswordStrengthTests.swift) copies were dropped as per-shell replays; Kotlin's HostedSyncErrorsTest.kt / SubscriptionStateTest.kt / VaultPasswordStrengthTest.kt are now the one asserted suite per rule. A new HostedError variant, a new subscription state, or a change to the strength thresholds must still land in every production copy in one commit — there is no shared fixture, only the test is consolidated.
